text.tspan: Figure 1. Study workflow and analysis chronology
ACC network-propagation drug-ranking audit with explicit seed-exposure controls
Topology audit: degree, strength and PageRank
External ACC literature classified by evidence type
No valid clinical negative comparator; AUC / calibration not
Same graph, drug universe, scoring and null design
Gate failed; later found asymmetric RB1 exposure
Primary ACC Top-20 reproduced by weighted overlap
A1 ACC vs A2 ACC−RB1; B1 breast vs B2 +RB1
Independent matched-null regeneration for every arm
Four normalizations plus exposed / unexposed controls
Complete rules passed in only 1 of 4 variants
Dirichlet coefficient and W1 / W2 assignment stress tests
Report locked and seed-excluded rankings together; treat rankings as prioritization outputs, not validated ACC efficacy predictions.
Direct-overlap baselines, degree-aware nulls and normalization sensitivity precede biological interpretation.
ACC, adrenocortical carcinoma; RWR, random walk with restart; MIPE, Mechanism Interrogation Plate.
